provenance.notes: Short mirror of G-TIME-L-01: market reflected around the base price, signals and side flipped. AUD-07 C11 corrected rule: exit at the close of candle i_in + N - 1 = 283 for every entry/exit cycle delay (here 15 s). Entry 99.98, exit 100 x 1.0002 = 100.02, qty 10/30; R = ((99.98 - 100.02) - (99.98 + 100.02) x 0.0005) / 30 = -0.0046667 (flat market: the same number as the long).
